name: Don Tracy

pages.title: Don Tracy for Illinois Senate | Fighting for Illinois Families
pages.text:
## About Don Tracy's Campaign
Cost-of-Living for Working Families
Illinois working families deserve someone who will work for them in Washington. I will fight to lower the cost-of-living so everyone in our great state can achieve their own version of the American Dream.
Champion Common Sense Solutions, Not Extreme Agendas
America needs common sense leadership that puts families first, strengthens our communities, and expands opportunity for the next generation.
Represent All of Illinois,
Too many of our politicians seem to forget Illinois has 102 counties, and the working families in every county deserve to have their voices heard. I will be proud to bring their voices to the halls of Congress.
Stay connected with the campaign. Sign up to receive updates from Don Tracy on the issues that matter to Illinois, upcoming events, volunteer opportunities, and important campaign announcements. Join our team and be among the first to hear the latest news as we work together to build a stronger future for Illinois.
## Frequently Asked Questions About Don Tracy for U.S. Senate
Don Tracy is an Illinois attorney, business leader, and Republican candidate for the United States Senate. The Don Tracy for U.S. Senate campaign focuses on issues including affordability, public safety, economic opportunity, and representing communities throughout Illinois.
Yes. Don Tracy is running for U.S. Senate in Illinois in 2026. The Don Tracy 2026 campaign is focused on bringing his priorities and vision for Illinois to the national level.
Don Tracy’s campaign emphasizes lowering the cost of living, supporting working families, improving public safety, encouraging economic opportunity, and advancing common-sense solutions. His campaign also stresses the importance of representing all of Illinois.
Don Tracy is running for U.S. Senate to advocate for Illinois families and communities and to defend the American Dream. His campaign argues that Illinoisans need effective representation on issues such as affordability, public safety, economic growth, and opportunity.
Affordability is a central issue for Don Tracy. His campaign has focused on the increasing cost of housing, groceries, utilities, health care, and other everyday expenses and on policies intended to help Illinois families keep more of what they earn.
Public safety is a key priority of the Don Tracy for U.S. Senate campaign. Don Tracy supports policies focused on accountability, community safety, and supporting law enforcement while addressing concerns about crime throughout Illinois.
Yes. A major part of the Don Tracy Illinois campaign is the message that Illinois needs representation that considers the needs of the entire state. His campaign emphasizes listening to voters and communities throughout Illinois, including areas outside Chicago.
Don Tracy’s campaign is focused on bringing a common-sense approach to Washington and advocating for Illinois families. His priorities include addressing the cost of living, protecting public safety, supporting economic opportunity, and defending the American Dream.
Illinois voters and supporters can get involved with the Don Tracy 2026 campaign by learning more about his platform, signing up for campaign updates, volunteering, donating, and sharing campaign information with others.
The official Don Tracy for U.S. Senate campaign website provides information about Don Tracy, his campaign priorities, current news, ways to get involved, and opportunities to support his 2026 campaign.
